typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		Date as date,
		{Reporting Month} as string,
		kWh as float,
		{Average kW} as float,
		{SLA Sev 1} as float,
		{SLA Sev 2} as float,
		{SLA Sev 3} as float,
		{Incident detail} as string,
		{Client Service Request } as float,
		{Cross connects } as float,
		{Client Service Request detail} as float,
		{On Site Support } as float,
		{Average Temperature Celsius} as float,
		{Average Relative Humidity} as float,
		{Power Availability} as string,
		{Billing Sterling} as string,
		{Maintenance completed in month } as float,
		{Deferred maintenance} as float,
		{Down time minutes} as float,
		{Permenant Access } as float
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName,
		PowerAvailability2 = toInteger(replace({Power Availability}, toString('%'), toString(''))) / 100) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		date as string,
		ClientServiceRequest as double,
		fname as string,
		UploadDate as string,
		ReportingMonth as string,
		OnSiteSupport as double,
		SLASev1 as double,
		AveragekW as double,
		SLASev2 as double,
		SLASev3 as double,
		DeferredMaintenance as double,
		PowerAvailability as double,
		AverageTemperatureCelsius as double,
		CrossConnects as double,
		MaintenanceCompletedInMonth as double,
		AverageRelativeHumidity as double,
		ClientServiceRequestDetail as double,
		EtlUser as string,
		BillingSterling as string,
		PermenantAccess as double,
		DownTimeMinutes as double,
		IncidentDetail as string,
		kwh as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		date = Date,
		ClientServiceRequest = {Client Service Request },
		fname = FName,
		UploadDate,
		ReportingMonth = {Reporting Month},
		OnSiteSupport = {On Site Support },
		SLASev1 = {SLA Sev 1},
		AveragekW = {Average kW},
		SLASev2 = {SLA Sev 2},
		SLASev3 = {SLA Sev 3},
		DeferredMaintenance = {Deferred maintenance},
		PowerAvailability = PowerAvailability2,
		AverageTemperatureCelsius = {Average Temperature Celsius},
		CrossConnects = {Cross connects },
		MaintenanceCompletedInMonth = {Maintenance completed in month },
		AverageRelativeHumidity = {Average Relative Humidity},
		ClientServiceRequestDetail = {Client Service Request detail},
		EtlUser,
		BillingSterling = {Billing Sterling},
		PermenantAccess = {Permenant Access },
		DownTimeMinutes = {Down time minutes},
		IncidentDetail = {Incident detail},
		kwh = kWh),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
